_comment: Grounded early-game progression checklist (Pallet -> Brock). Each subgoal is the CURRENT objective fed to the model until its done-condition (checkable from the RAM snapshot) fires, then the next becomes current. Map ids / item id 70 (OAK'S PARCEL) / badge bit 0x01 (Boulder) are all real. Extend past Brock as the fleet clears it.

subgoals.objective: Get your first Pokemon: in Oak's Lab, walk directly below one of the three Poke Balls and interact to take that starter.
Go NORTH from Pallet Town up Route 1 to Viridian City, enter the Poke Mart, and talk to the clerk to receive OAK'S PARCEL.
Return SOUTH to Pallet Town and enter OAK'S LAB (not your own house), then talk to Prof. Oak to deliver OAK'S PARCEL. He gives you the POKEDEX.
With the POKEDEX, go north again through Viridian City and take the NORTH exit to Route 2 (the man who was blocking the way is gone).
Travel north through Route 2 into VIRIDIAN FOREST, then out its north gate to Pewter City. Battle the Bug Catchers on the way to level up (aim for level 12-14 before Brock).
Enter PEWTER GYM and defeat Brock to win the BOULDER BADGE.
You won the BOULDER BADGE! Head EAST out of Pewter City onto Route 3, toward Mt. Moon.
Travel EAST across Route 3 (beat the trainers) to the Mt. Moon entrance and go inside.
Cross Mt. Moon to its EAST exit (to Route 4, toward Cerulean City). Battle the Team Rocket grunts and Super Nerds inside.
